messages:
Ashley Chen: kicking off Riverbank LoRA merge + int4 smoke for customer Riverbank. uploading a compact eval pack now, heads up about possible tokenization shifts.
Kevin Patel: what's in the eval pack? quick benchmarks?
Ashley Chen: minimal: 100 QA pairs, 20 multi-turn flows, 50 typical API prompts. checks: token parity, response length, hallucination rate, basic F1/EM.
Maria Gomez: did you run the tokenizer remap step? last time we saw off-by-one on hyphenated tokens.
Ashley Chen: ran `scripts/token-remap.py --model riverbank-v1 --apply` — no warnings. sample diff: `orig: "co-operate" -> tokens: 4` vs `new: 3` (small but present).
eval-bot: smoke results uploaded: /results/riverbank/4793456789 — embedding drift 0.4%, F1 delta -0.02, token shift 0.6%
Kevin Patel: 0.6% token shift is slightly over customer SLA (they expect <0.5). can we tighten?
Sue Park: suggestion: try warmstart stitch instead of hard merge. warmstart preserved tokenmap last week.
Maria Gomez: also run with prefix cache disabled and batching set low — batching can mask tail regressions.
Ashley Chen: starting warmstart stitch now. disabling prefix cache and running 5x per prompt for variance. ETA ~20m.
Kevin Patel: if F1 drops >0.05 open a regression ticket and tag @oncall-ml.
Ashley Chen: noted. linking smoke report (internal): https://redwood.internal/results/riverbank/4793456789
eval-bot: warmstart run complete. Results: F1 delta -0.015, token shift 0.19%, latency +3ms p95. recommendation: proceed to canary.
Kevin Patel: ok go to canary at 5% traffic. monitor hallucination alerts closely — rollback if hallucination >0.8% within 60m.
Sue Park: I'll prepare the canary rollout config: `canary: {percent: 5, window: 60m, fallback: riverbank-v1}`
Maria Gomez: grabbing a few negative examples from the run to add to the regression corpus.
Ashley Chen: added 12 failing prompts to /eval/riverbank/regressions/4793456789.json
Kevin Patel: thanks team. :thumbsup: we'll reconvene after the canary window.
